thread:
maya: Quick check: folks keep missing the pin action in compact mode. Feels decorative.

sam: Can we show a small 'Pinned' chip and a hover label 'Pin rule to top'?

jordan: Also add the action to the kebab menu and surface a keyboard shortcut in the tooltip (Ctrl+Shift+P).

devin: The simulator control disappears when rules are collapsed. Suggest a tiny sticky sim widget in the editor header (play/pause + last-run).

aria: Accessibility: pin icon has no accessible name in compact list. Need aria-label="Pin rule to top" and aria-pressed state. Also fix tab order so pin is focused before body.

sam: Validation copy: replace generic 'Rule conflict' with 'Conflicting rules detected — adjust priorities or pin a rule to resolve.' Add a small 'Learn more' link.

maya: Agreement on defaults: simulate draft by default, with dropdown to run against last published snapshot. Show warning for very large policies.

jordan: I'll update Figma and post frames shortly.

design-ci-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz987/routing-editor-updates frames 10-14 (jordan).

devin: I'll do an a11y/keyboard pass when frames land and report back.
